dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High-contrast white spots on the distal portions of the flight feathers create a sharply defined, discontinuous boundary against the dark gray feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: An irregular, high-contrast reddish-brown patch is visible on the posterior neck and nape area.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct and linear color transition separates the reddish-brown crown and nape from the uniform gray plumage of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-contrast white circular spots are visible on the rectrices, contrasting with the dark gray base color of the tail.
